### What happened\n\nDescribe the issue and the steps to reproduce it.

Accepts .zip packages with meta.json (adrenotools format) or an ARM64 .so file: Turnip for Adreno, PanVK for Mali, and other Mesa drivers for PowerVR or MediaTek. If the driver fails, the game returns to the system driver.
The GPU and driver in use appear after you start the game.
The driver file could not be read.
This is not a valid driver package. Use a .zip with meta.json and the library, or a .so file.
The driver must be an ARM64 (arm64-v8a) library.
The custom driver did not work on this phone, so the game used the system driver. The system driver is selected again.
The game closed while starting with the custom driver. The system driver is selected again.
